description.narrative: The proposed investment is the project financing of a 120 MW greenfield onshore wind power plant in Ukraine (the Project). The project is undertaken by a special purpose company incorporated in Ukraine. The project is expected to sell its electricity under a corporate power purchase agreement.

This project will increase the supply of sustainable electricity in Ukraine while reducing c. 213,000 tons of CO2 emissions annually. Additionally, it will improve the resilience of Ukraines power sector by adding 120 MW of renewable energy capacity, thereby increasing investments in renewable energy for reconstruction and diversifying the countrys energy mix. The project will also improve the competitiveness of Ukraines power sector by demonstrating the viability of corporate power purchase agreements and the feasibility of developing privately financed renewable energy projects without public support.
